title: Alma Bank Announces Agreement to Acquire American Community Bank, Creating a Premier Community Banking Franchise Across New York and New Jersey
summary: Alma Bank, American Community Bancorp, Inc. and American Community Bank jointly announced today that they have entered into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger pursuant to which Alma Bank will acquire American Community Bank.
